'''Maciej Bolesław Lampe''' (born February 5, 1985) is a Polish former professional [[basketball]] player. Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=11}}, he played at the [[power forward]] and [[Center (basketball)|center]] positions.

==Professional career==
===Sweden and Spain===
{{Cleanup|section|date=April 2015|reason=content was written in non-encyclopedic way, citations missing, NBA transactions shouldn't be listed but implemented in text, etc.}}
Originally from [[Łódź]], Poland, Lampe grew up in [[Stockholm]], Sweden. He played briefly for [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] in the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB League]] before being sent on loan to [[Universidad Complutense (basketball team)|Universidad Complutense]] of the [[Liga Española de Baloncesto|LEB]], the second division level in Spain, to receive more playing time.

===NBA===
Lampe was selected by the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] club the [[New York Knicks]] in the second round (30th overall) of the [[2003 NBA draft]] as an early entry candidate, despite having been projected as a top five [[NBA draft lottery|lottery pick]]. Lampe was elected to the 2003 [[Rocky Mountain Revue|Reebok Rocky Mountain Revue]] All-Revue Team after averaging 17.2 points and 7.0 rebounds in 32.4 minutes for the Knicks' summer league team. Lampe was traded to the [[Phoenix Suns]] on January 5, 2004, deal, and at the time, he became the youngest player in Suns history to appear in a regular season game, as well as the first Suns player to play while being 18 years old.

In January 2005, he got traded for the second time in his NBA career, this time to the [[New Orleans Hornets|New Orleans/Oklahoma City Hornets]]. On February 13, 2006, he was traded to the [[Houston Rockets]] for [[point guard]] [[Moochie Norris]], making the Rockets his fourth NBA club. He played the total number of 61 games in NBA. He holds NBA career averages of 3.4 points per game, 2.2 rebounds per game, and 0.3 assists per game.

Lampe's final NBA game was played on April 4, 2006, in a 87–104 loss to the [[Seattle SuperSonics]] where he recorded 1 rebound in only 2 and half minutes of playing time.
In 2010, he was selected by the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] to play on the Summer League team.

====NBA transactions====
* June 26, 2003 – Selected with the 30th pick by the [[New York Knicks]] (the pick originally belonged to the [[Denver Nuggets]] and was acquired by the Knicks in the [[Marcus Camby]] deal).
* August 13, 2003 – Signed a 3-year, $2.9 million contract with the Knicks
* January 5, 2004 – Traded with [[Antonio McDyess]], [[Howard Eisley]], [[Charlie Ward]], rights to [[Miloš Vujanić]], 2004 first-round draft pick (used to select [[Kirk Snyder]]), future first-round draft pick (used in 2010 to select [[Gordon Hayward]]) and $3 million to the [[Phoenix Suns]] for [[Stephon Marbury]], [[Penny Hardaway]] and [[Cezary Trybański]].
* January 21, 2005 – Traded with [[Casey Jacobsen]] and [[Jackson Vroman]] to the [[New Orleans Hornets]] for [[Jim Jackson (basketball)|Jim Jackson]] and 2005 second-round draft pick (used to select [[Marcin Gortat]]).
* February 13, 2006 – Traded to the [[Houston Rockets]] for [[Moochie Norris]].

===Russia===
Lampe signed a one-year deal with the [[ULEB Cup]] (now called [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]) club [[BC Dynamo Saint Petersburg|Dynamo Saint Petersburg]], however the team went bankrupt shortly thereafter. The bankrupt Dynamo squad was thrown out of the [[Russian Superleague A]] one day before the start of the season. Thus, Lampe moved to [[BC Khimki|Khimki]]. In February 2008, Khimki beat [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] in the [[Russian Basketball Cup|Russian Cup]] final and Lampe was awarded the best player ([[Most valuable player|MVP]]) of the cup final. He then signed a three-year contract extension with Khimki.

Lampe returned to Russia in January 2010, signing with [[BC UNICS|UNICS Kazan]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20100122120959/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/ulebcup/home/news/i/65470/3735 UNICS Kazan inks big man Maciej Lampe]</ref> He was voted the [[2010–11 Russian Professional Basketball League|2010–11 season's]] [[Russian Professional Basketball League Awards|Russian PBL MVP]] for the regular season.<ref>[http://www.pbleague.ru/en/news/897 Maciej Lampe - the MVP of the BEKO PBL Regular season]</ref>

===Israel===
Lampe signed a one-year deal with an option for another season with the [[Ligat Winner|Israeli Super League]] club [[Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]] in July 2009.<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2009-10-signings/i/54649/3694/maccabi-big-man-maciej-lampe-signs MACCABI: Big man Maciej Lampe signs], ''Euroleague.net'' {{in lang|en}}</ref>

===Spain===
In July 2011 he signed with [[Saski Baskonia|Caja Laboral Vitoria]] for two seasons.<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2011-12-signings/i/86544/5611/caja-laboral-brings-in-lampe-for-2-years CAJA LABORAL brings in Lampe for 2 years]</ref> In December 2012, Lampe was named [[EuroLeague MVP of the Month|the MVP of the month of December]] in the [[2012–13 Euroleague|2012–13 EuroLeague]].<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/106516/180 bwin MVP for December: Maciej Lampe, Caja Laboral Vitoria]</ref>

In August 2013, he signed a three-year contract with [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]].<ref>{{cite web|title=FC Barcelona announced Maciej Lampe|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/spain/60845/fc-barcelona-announced-maciej-lampe.html|publisher=Sportando.net|access-date=3 August 2013}}</ref> Barcelona paid Baskonia 1.5 million euros for the transfer.<ref>[https://www.baskonistas.com/de-ramn-rivas-a-tibor-pleiss-cronologa-de-los-traspasos-del-baskonia-al-fc-barcelona/?srsltid=AfmBOorrvP7aewsQ--gLED4d2zncmHPSX_TQQjCx6Yo721tMS5rKvtlM De Ramón Rivas a Adam Hanga, cronología de los traspasos entre el Baskonia y el FC Barcelona], baskonistas.com</ref>

===China===
In July 2016, Lampe signed with the [[Shenzhen Leopards]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Maciej Lampe (ex Besiktas) joins DongGuan Leopards|url=http://www.asia-basket.com/China/news/455382/Maciej-Lampe-(ex-Besiktas)-joins-DongGuan-Leopards|work=Asia-Basket.com|date=July 24, 2016|access-date=October 2, 2016}}</ref> He was replaced on the roster before the 2017–18 season with [[Jared Sullinger]] because of injury. In November 2017, Lampe signed with the [[Qingdao Eagles]].<ref>{{cite news|title=青岛签下兰佩琼斯正式离队|url=http://news.ifeng.com/a/20171127/53627197_0.shtml|work=ifeng|date=November 27, 2017|access-date=November 30, 2017}}</ref>

On August 19, 2019, he has signed with [[Sichuan Blue Whales]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/sichuan-whales-sign-maciej-lampe-and-jerryd-bayless/|title=Sichuan Whales sign Maciej Lampe and Jerryd Bayless|date=August 19, 2019|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 19, 2019 |last1=Carchia |first1=Emiliano }}</ref> On October 16, 2019, replaced by [[Thomas Robinson (basketball)|Thomas Robinson]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Emiliano Carchia |title=Thomas Robinson agreed to terms with Sichuan |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/thomas-robinson-agreed-to-terms-with-sichuan/ |accessdate=2023-11-21 |work=Sportando |date=2019-10-16 |archive-date=January 31, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230131194121/https://sportando.basketball/en/thomas-robinson-agreed-to-terms-with-sichuan/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |author1=何鹏楠 |title=兰佩暂别四川男篮 前北控外援成为"备胎" |url=https://news.sina.com.cn/o/2019-10-17/doc-iicezuev2858324.shtml |accessdate=2023-11-21 |work=红星新闻 |date=2019-10-17}}</ref>

===Poland===
On December 31, 2020, he has signed with [[Wilki Morskie Szczecin]] of the [[Polish Basketball League|PLK]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/maciej-lampe-joins-king-wilki-morskie-szczecin/|title=Maciej Lampe joins King Wilki Morskie Szczecin|date=December 31, 2020|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=December 31, 2020 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }}</ref>

===Taiwan===
On September 9, 2021, he has signed with [[TaiwanBeer HeroBears]] of the [[T1 League]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=鍾東穎 |title=NBA太陽最年輕出賽球員 波蘭一哥加盟台啤英熊 |url=https://www.nownews.com/news/5375848 |accessdate=2021-09-09 |work=NOWnews |date=2021-09-09}}</ref> On December 24, Lampe took a plane to Spain for recovery.<ref>{{cite news |title=台啤英熊籃波無預警離台？ 小腿肌肉撕裂傷返國治療 |url=https://sports.ettoday.net/news/2154199 |accessdate=January 1, 2022 |work=ETtoday |date=December 25, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=籃波一場未打就離隊 台啤英熊已尋找替代洋將 |url=https://udn.com/news/story/7003/5988219 |accessdate=January 1, 2022 |work=United Daily News |date=December 25, 2021}}</ref>
